## Learning-as-a-Service

With our Learning-as-a-Service offering (LaaS), you can ensure the
continuous development of your Doxis skills – in a predictable,
cost-effective and long-term manner.


- Discounted credit packages as part of a subscription
- Continuous access to up-to-date learning content
- E-learning on new release updates included
- Certifications for targeted skills development
- Discounted team training for up to 12 participants


Ensure sustainable professional development and keep your
Doxis knowledge up to date at all times.


[![](https://academy.doxis.com/lms/uploads/7adde551f986405d614cd628.jpg)](https://www.doxis.com/files/extensions/medien/documents/broschueren/EN/Doxis-Academy_Learning-as-a-Service_EN.pdf)[Download](https://www.doxis.com/files/extensions/medien/documents/broschueren/EN/Doxis-Academy_Learning-as-a-Service_EN.pdf)

## Training Catalog

With our training catalog, you can keep an overview of your professional
development opportunities and create a reliable basis for structured
planning of your Doxis training.


- Comprehensive offering covering key Doxis topics
- Training for specific tasks and application scenarios
- Develop your employees into competent Doxis solution professionals
- Strong practical focus for quick application in everyday work
- Completion certificate as proof of the knowledge acquired

Choose the training that best suits your specific development needs.

## Your Benefits with Doxis Academy.

Learn how to maximize the effectiveness of the Doxis solutions at your company!

+

Whether beginner or expert: choose the right learning path and expand your Doxis knowledge based on your individual level of expertise.


+

Choose from a variety of learning models and booking options to suit your individual requirements and learning goals.



Live Training

Learn live from our experts and deepen your Doxis knowledge with practical content and specific use cases.

Blended Learning

Combine flexible self-paced learning with interactive live training and deepen your Doxis knowledge in a practical and lasting way.

Web Based Training

Learn flexibly and at your own pace with digital training content and expand your Doxis knowledge anytime, anywhere.

+

Discover a wide range of learning formats that flexibly adapt to your individual learning needs and daily work routine.


+

Learn flexibly whenever and wherever it suits you, independent of time and location and aligned with your daily work routine.
